name: riffkit
description: The official Riffkit plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: riffkit
plugins.description: Change the outfit, person, place or product in a short video and keep every shot, or turn a winning short video into your own: give one source (a video of your own, a TikTok link, or an analyzed template) or just an idea, and the backend makes the AI video (post-ready short-form or UGC-style ad creative), with optional digital character, product placement, and language.
